phase.title: Project skeleton and development tooling
phase.goal: Create a minimal, reproducible project foundation without implementing agent behavior prematurely.

why_this_phase_exists: Establish reproducible tooling and explicit dependency rules before runtime behavior is introduced.
context: The system is a generic, bounded agent runtime driven through an RPC-style API.
Factory-specific behavior belongs in the separate mock tool server, not in the runtime core.
The runtime must be implemented directly rather than wrapped around an existing agent framework.
in_scope: Use and document Python 3.13 with uv as the language, runtime, and dependency manager for this project.
Document the intended boundaries between the agent core, RPC transport, persistence, LLM providers, MCP integration, and the mock MCP server.
Create only the minimal directories and files needed for the foundation; add later modules when their behavior is implemented.
Document dependency rules that keep infrastructure and SDK dependencies outside the Agent Loop.
Add formatting, linting, type-checking, and test commands.
Add configuration loading with an example environment file that contains no secrets.
Add a concise README with setup and development commands.
Add CI that runs deterministic local checks.
out_of_scope: Speculative empty AgentLoop, MCP adapter, provider adapter, or persistence repository classes
Dependency injection frameworks and a large package hierarchy
boundaries_introduced: The Agent Loop core must remain importable without RPC frameworks, database implementations, MCP SDKs, or provider SDKs.
RPC, provider, MCP, persistence, and mock server components are separate change boundaries even when their concrete technologies remain deferred.
Factory-specific behavior belongs only in the independently runnable mock MCP server.
contracts_introduced: No runtime contract is implemented in this foundation-only phase.
deliverables: Formatting, linting, type-checking, and test configuration
Example configuration and local setup instructions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new contributor can install dependencies and run all documented checks from a clean checkout.
The core package and baseline tests can be imported without importing RPC frameworks, provider SDKs, MCP SDKs, or database implementations.
No secret or machine-specific path is committed.
The baseline test command succeeds without network access.
The scaffold contains no placeholder runtime classes, persistence repositories, or dependency-injection setup for behavior deferred to later phases.

required_tests: Follow README setup steps from a clean environment where practical.
Verify the core import path does not load RPC, provider, MCP, or database packages.
deferred_decisions: Exact Agent Loop termination policy and numeric execution limits
exit_condition: The foundation is reproducible and the architectural boundaries are present, while all runtime behavior remains deferred to later phases.
